prop.T_SL = T_SL
THEN con.optimal_point_continuous()
seed order matters: the solve must see this thrust

span.p:
2. tail_result = tail.size()
NO arguments; it reads geom live
geom.S_ht, geom.S_vt = tail_result

span.p:
3. prop.T_SL = T_SL
BEFORE the constraint solve

span.p:

EVERY pass, warm-started
T_SL_new = TW * W0

W_OEW = wts.get_OEW(W0)

W test AND T test

W0 = relax(W0, W0_new, relax_W)
T_SL = relax(T_SL, T_SL_new, relax_T)

T_SL = T_SL_new
converged = true
